label: Inspection Status Transitions
info:
Status transitions of an Inspection.

`Created -> Defined` and `-> Assigned` used to be written by the web app as a plain `updateEntity` on the `status` field, which meant the state machine was enforced only in the browser and any authenticated caller could jump an inspection to any state.

These two endpoints own those transitions instead. The caller names the *action*, never the target status, so the gateway proxy can gate each one by role, and the rules that were in compliance_web's src/utils/inspectionStatus.js are applied here:

  GET /inspectionDefine?inspection=<id>   Defined, only from Created
  GET /inspectionAssign?inspection=<id>   Assigned, from Defined or Planned

`Planned -> Assigned` is the reassignment revert: assigning different inspectors to an inspection that already has a plan sends it back to Assigned so the plan is regenerated.

The other transitions already live in flows: `-> Planned` in Inspection Plan, `Planned -> Uploaded` in Import Canonical, `-> Reported` in Inspection Report.
